name: Palette Previewer
author: David Sims
description: A handy tool to preview four-color palettes on WASM-4: browse the palettes and see how each one looks on a sample image, with its name and author.

descriptions.en: A handy tool to preview four-color palettes on WASM-4: browse the palettes and see how each one looks on a sample image, with its name and author.
descriptions.it: Uno strumento per provare tavolozze a quattro colori su WASM-4: sfoglia le palette e guarda come rendono su un'immagine di esempio, con nome e autore.
